title: French Piquant Pork Quiche
description: A savory French-inspired quiche filled with tender pork, piquant flavor, and a flaky crust.
instructions: Roll out the pie crust and place in a 9-inch tart pan.
In a skillet, cook the diced pork and onion over medium heat until browned.
Add the chopped piquant and minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the beaten eggs and shredded cheese.
Season the egg mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Arrange the cooked pork mixture in the pie crust.
Pour the egg mixture over the pork mixture.
Bake the quiche for 35-40 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the eggs are set.
Let the quiche cool for 10 minutes before serving.
